newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global to buy Crop-Maker Soil Service.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global to buy Crop-Maker Soil Service.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Crop-Maker Soil Service Inc for an undisclosed price.

IMC Global said Crop-Maker operates five retail farm service centers in Indiana, posting annual sales of about $11 million. Each center offers crop nutrients, seeds and agricultural chemicals, IMC Global said.
The deal would increase the number of IMC Global retail farm centers nationwide to more than 200, the company said.
IMC Global is a leading manufacturer of crop nutrients. Its stock was up 1-5/8 Monday at 41-3/8.
